verdict.rationale: Mercury Books says accounts reconcile automatically and continuously, and its built-in Command assistant can take bookkeeping tasks such as journal entries and bulk categorization; accountants can be invited to review transactions and comment on them. However, the API and MCP layer for external agents to run bookkeeping end-to-end is only promised as "soon," and Mercury itself says the product is not autopilot. There is no evidence of an agent-driven month-end close workflow. Missing for 10: a shipped agent/MCP or API path for end-to-end reconciliation, documented exception flagging during reconciliation (only duplicate-bill detection is shown), a month-end close preparation and review workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
